## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      8 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 12.09.2026 - 20.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Amy H_, 19.09.2026, 1/5: "DO NOT USE THIS APP. I canceled before my trial ended and I still got charged.very hard to get ahold of and when I did they basically said sorry!!! Don't waste your money!!"
            2. _Tessa Wilde_, 20.09.2026, 4/5: "amazing app!! I would have given 5 stars, but I'm unable to continue app due to price is way too high."
            3. _DeOsha Ann_, 19.09.2026, 4/5: "I love the everyday workouts 💪 I just wish the BetterMe Tracker wasn't so expensive, I'd buy it. Customer service is very good with their response times and are very helpful."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      6 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 23.05.2026 - 15.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Bonolo Rambau_, 15.09.2026, 1/5: "the app glitches, i can't even access my meal plan. I have been a member for less than an hour"
            2. _Sabina Kotiranta_, 23.05.2026, 1/5: "would be nice if it stops crashing.... Reinstalled it twice now."
            3. _Bartholomew Lunt_, 23.07.2026, 2/5: "daily work out is good but it keeps crashing and I can't track anything except the daily workout once it actually loads."
<!--/ir-theme-->
